title.zh: Energy-Based Reasoners：把循环推理做成潜在状态上的能量下降，Sudoku-Extreme 上 1.8M 参数、99.9% 准确率，推理计算据称比次优模型少 345 倍

summary.zh: 项目页 energy-based-reasoners.github.io（HN 300/52）与 arXiv 2611.08977（William Chen、Alexi Gladstone、Zeyu Li、Heng Ji、Yilun Du；Duke / UIUC / Harvard）：Energy-Based Reasoners（EBR）在潜在推理状态上学习能量函数，把循环更新写成对该能量的梯度下降——能量用来给候选打分（不需要外部验证器），梯度用来 refinement，并在梯度范数低于阈值时停止。作者还引入基于探索的训练，以发现更多模态、在更宽的状态集上塑造能量面。四个算法推理基准上，1.8M 参数的 EBR 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上单样本 99.4%、5 次采样 99.9%，并称比次优模型（文中为 EqR）少用 345 倍推理 FLOPs，训练计算相当；自适应停止比固定深度 EBR 少约 10.9 倍 FLOPs 仍保持 99.9%。N-Queens 与 Graph Coloring 上称覆盖率领先，单样本准确率接近 100%。HN 条目标题写「385x」，与项目页/论文的 345× 不符，以项目页为准。数字均作者自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: Project page energy-based-reasoners.github.io (HN 300/52) and arXiv 2611.08977 (William Chen, Alexi Gladstone, Zeyu Li, Heng Ji, Yilun Du; Duke / UIUC / Harvard): Energy-Based Reasoners (EBRs) learn an energy function over latent reasoning states and treat looped updates as gradient descent on that energy. The energy scores candidates without an external verifier; its gradient guides refinement and, once its norm falls below a threshold, stopping. Exploration-based training is used to find more modes and shape the energy landscape over a broader set of states. On four algorithmic reasoning benchmarks, a 1.8M-parameter EBR is reported to reach 99.4% single-sample and 99.9% with 5 samples on Sudoku-Extreme, using 345× less inference FLOPs than the next-best model (EqR in the write-up) at comparable training compute; adaptive stopping is said to keep 99.9% with about 10.9× fewer FLOPs than a fixed-depth EBR. On N-Queens and Graph Coloring the authors claim state-of-the-art coverage of distinct valid solutions with near-100% single-sample accuracy. The HN item is titled “385x”; that figure does not match the 345× on the project page and paper, which are treated as authoritative here. Figures are the authors’ own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 偏见头测到的也许根本不是偏见：头级偏见归因里，选头统计量无法被识别为在测偏见，消融所谓偏见头也降不了不公平率

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.23218（S.M Seefat Alam）：把社会偏见定位到个别注意力头、再靠消融来「去偏见」的方法，其实是用公平指标的事后效果来验证，从未证明那个选头统计量在测偏见。作者在 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上审计：头图虽与标签盲的回复长度图高度相关（ρ=-0.950 与 -0.768），好像找到了表层混杂；但固定提示后，长度只解释该统计量 1% 的方差，真正解释 64% 的是提示身份，且排序并不随长度单调。同一提示内，公平标签、回复长度与受保护群体词几乎共线（φ=0.95），部分是标注规则本身使然，观察分析无法归因，这一家族的方法也没有做能做此区分的实验。实质主张同样不成立：两种读法下偏见选择性都不集中在后层；测试过的头集合消融后都不能降低不公平率；而其补集（按相反标签计分）却能稳定破坏拒答（p=2.7×10⁻⁵），说明这套管线在该尺度上确实能测到效应，只是测到的不是「偏见头」。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.23218 (S.M Seefat Alam) audits methods that localise social bias to individual attention heads and “debias” by ablating them. Those methods are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic used to choose the heads measures bias. On Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the head map correlates at ρ = -0.950 and -0.768 with a label-blind response-length map, which looks like a surface confound; an intervention that holds the prompt fixed rejects that reading, because length then explains only 1% of the statistic’s variance. Prompt identity explains 64%, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at φ = 0.95, partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map, and no method in this family runs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated under either reference reading, and no head set tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal (p = 2.7×10⁻⁵), so the pipeline detects effects at this scale, but not a bias head. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 能排出先后，并不等于知道落在哪一格：语言模型可以把政党立场排好序，却无法把单个政党放到同一尺度上

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.21878（Yousef Attia、Jarosław A. Chudziak）：现有基准几乎都在问「单个实体打几分」，并把它当成模型掌握了该领域；但文本里比较远多于测量，模型可能只有可靠排序、没有锚定的刻度。作者以日韩政党立场为试验台（比较宣言计划的编码数据作外部答案键）：给四个政党排序时，模型超过最强固定答案基线一倍以上；把单个政党放到同一尺度上，则低于该基线。失败的绝对定位里排序仍然保留，补上编码数值后定位接近天花板。因此，对同一事实的比较问题与绝对问题在这里测的不是同一件事，用其中一种建成的基准不能代表另一种。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.21878 (Yousef Attia, Jarosław A. Chudziak) argues that nearly every benchmark of gradable social positions asks about one entity at a time and then reads that score as the model’s knowledge of the domain. Text about social entities carries far more comparison than measurement, so a model may hold a dependable ordering with no anchored scale. On party positions in Japan and South Korea, with the Comparative Manifesto Project’s coded data as an external answer key, models beat the strongest fixed-answer baseline by more than a factor of two when asked to order four parties, and fall below that baseline when asked to place one party on the same scale. The ordering survives inside those failed placements, and supplying the coded values lifts placement to near ceiling. Comparative and absolute questions about the same fact therefore measure different things here, and a benchmark built from one cannot speak for the other. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.21705 (Davide Liga, Liuwen Yu, Matteo Magnini) asks whether the attention heads and SAE features that change a model’s answer to a moral prompt respond to moral content, to the judgment of conduct by any norm, or to the word “morally” in the prompt. They built 227 minimal pairs, validated by five annotators, that differ in a moral standard, in another kind of norm (prudence, etiquette, aesthetics or evidence), or in a descriptive quality, and tested 14 open-weight models (Llama, Gemma and Qwen, 1B to 14B, base and instruction-tuned) with and without the word “morally”. In every model, the heads that change the moral answer belong to an evaluation circuit used for every kind of normative judgment tested: with the cue word, these heads carry the same share of the effect for moral as for other normative pairs (pooled ratio 1.00, 97.5% CI [0.92, 1.07]; 0.90, [0.84, 0.96] without it), and the models need them as much for both, including when the prompt does not ask for a judgment. On 400 ETHICS scenarios, removing them takes away 37 to 39% of the gap between acceptable and unacceptable scenarios, against 1 to 3% for ten random heads. The SAE features located respond mostly to the word “morally” rather than to what the phrase is about. The category of a pair can be read from hidden states; in the eight models tested, removing the direction that carries it weakens the moral verdict by a few percent, and more than the other verdicts in seven of them. The pairs, ratings, code, trained SAE dictionaries and result files are to be released. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t708. Do not retest the already-failed term sparse autoencoders. Chaos only.

title.zh: Conserved Verdicts：推理模型已经答对之后继续想，仍可能把正确答案想丢——该不该停，要看承诺与裁决之差，而不是最终正确性探针

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.21946（Jianghong Zhou、Hao Rong、Chen Lin）：推理模型已经答对之后继续想，仍可能把正确答案想丢。作者把链上同一时刻的两个概率分开：现在停下答案正确的概率叫承诺（commitment），最终答案正确的概率叫裁决（verdict）；仅用裁决——也就是最终正确性探针所估计的量——无法决定该不该停，因为它作为对既定结果的预报没有可预期的漂移；承诺–裁决差才等于继续思考还预期改变多少质量，也等于现在停下能拿到的准确率增益。第二条恒等式再把准确率随预算变化的曲线拆成「链内答案变化」与「还在跑的是哪些链」。在 MATH-500 上，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 在已持有正确答案的 379 个点（选取时不考虑链条如何结束）继续想，平均再丢 3.6 分（95% CI [2.2, 5.2]），损失集中在少数题。六个推理模型、MATH-500 与 OlympiadBench、预算至 16,384 token 时，准确率随预算下降主要来自「还在跑的是哪些链」，而仍在推理的链本身往往保住或改进答案。神谕式停止规则在 1.5B 与 7B 上最多只再得 +1.8 与 +2.5 分。框架要先说明该测什么，再去造停止规则。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.21946 (Jianghong Zhou, Hao Rong, Chen Lin) notes that a reasoning model that has reached a correct answer can lose it by continuing to think. At a point on a chain, commitment is the probability that the answer the model would give if stopped now is correct, and verdict is the probability that the answer it will finish with is correct. The verdict alone, which is what final-correctness probes estimate, cannot decide whether to stop: as a forecast of a fixed outcome it has no predictable drift. The commitment-verdict gap equals the expected remaining change in answer quality and the accuracy gained by stopping. A second identity splits any accuracy-versus-budget curve into answer change within chains and change in which chains are still running. On MATH-500, at all 379 points where DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B holds a correct answer, selected without regard to how its chain ends, continuing loses 3.6 points on average (95% CI [2.2, 5.2]), and the loss concentrates in a few problems. In six reasoning models from three families, on MATH-500 and OlympiadBench and with budgets up to 16,384 tokens, declining accuracy curves come from which chains remain, while the chains still reasoning keep or improve their answers. An oracle stopping rule gains at most +1.8 and +2.5 points at 1.5B and 7B. The framework says what to measure before building a stopping rule. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: LABEL：药品适应症与禁忌症在公开文本里的记录不对称——好处被写到的次数大约是安全限制的两倍，扩大模型只抬高适应症准确率

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.19166（S M Rayeed、Charles V. Stewart、Yao Ma）把药品「适应症 vs 禁忌症」在公开文本里的记录不对称命名为 LABEL。对 PrimeKG 中 574 种药物，在 Wikipedia 与 PubMed 摘要里，同一药物的好处被写到的次数大约是安全限制的两倍（文内比值 2.19）。语言模型跟着这个缺口走：Qwen2.5 从 0.5B 扩到 14B，适应症准确率升 18.3 分，禁忌症却一直接近随机；只要检索到写明答案的段落，两类事实用得一样好；把安全问题转到官方 FDA 标签，在标签写明该事实时还能再升 15.8 分。结论：模型在用药安全上失败，主要是因为自由文本语料缺少安全事实，而不是不会推理风险。代码与数据自称公开于 github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.19166 (S M Rayeed, Charles V. Stewart, Yao Ma) names LABEL (Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits) for the documentation gap between a drug’s indications and contraindications in public prose. Across 574 drugs from PrimeKG, Wikipedia articles and PubMed abstracts are said to name a drug’s benefits about twice as often as its safety limits (within-drug odds ratio 2.19). Language models mirror the gap: as Qwen2.5 scales from 0.5B to 14B, accuracy on indications rises by 18.3 points, while accuracy on contraindications stays near random guessing. title.zh: Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked：在过程级真奖励可精确计算的试验台上，过宽的验证器会被「注水」——代理分到 0.940，真实忠实度却从 0.731 掉到 0.667

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.21538（Arunkumar V、Manoranjan Gandhudi、Gangadharan G. R.、Arun Prakash、S. Senthilkumar）：在 124,416 个上下文的可执行授权策略上，用精确过程级真奖励作试验台，再把验证器沿结果-only、充分性、召回、抽取噪声、粗糙分类、过期策略、LLM 裁判七条轴降质，同时用精确验证器给每个 rollout 打分。出现四种表型：乐观验证器会被「注水」——充分性代理分到 0.940，真实忠实度却从 0.731 掉到 0.667（96 个留出回合）；只看结果的验证器会饱和后不再教；噪声会稀释；保序的分差则无害。用验证器的选择误差和分差符号，加上短饱和试跑，可预判会落入哪一种。九种配置下表型会再现；充分性损伤在全部 10 个复制单元里为正，其中 7 个超出两倍标准差。损伤幅度本身未能复现。试验台与 14 条真实公开策略（Cedar、OPA、Gatekeeper）自称将公开。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t822、t908。不用已失败词 RLVR 作主词。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.21538 (Arunkumar V, Manoranjan Gandhudi, Gangadharan G. R., Arun Prakash, S. Senthilkumar) builds a testbed where true reward is exactly computable at the process level: executable authorization policies over 124,416 contexts admit an oracle for every minimal sufficient reason. Verifiers are then degraded along seven axes (outcome-only, sufficiency, recall-only, extraction noise, coarse taxonomy, stale policy, LLM judge) while the exact verifier scores every rollout. Four phenotypes appear. Optimistic verifiers are hacked by padding: a sufficiency proxy ends at 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731 to 0.667 on 96 held-out episodes. Outcome-only verifiers saturate and stop teaching; noise dilutes; ranking-preserving gaps do no harm. A model-free audit of selection error and gap sign, plus a short saturation pilot, is said to anticipate the phenotype. Across nine configurations the phenotypes recur; sufficiency damage is positive in all 10 replication cells and beyond two standard errors in 7. The damage magnitude does not replicate. The testbed and 14 real public policies (Cedar, OPA, Gatekeeper) are to be released. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t822 and t908. Do not use the already-failed term RLVR. Chaos only.

title.zh: Role-filler binding：残差流里的线性探针几乎满分能读出角色，可言语化工作区的读数却低于随机对照——建在这些方向上的运行时监控会漏掉模型已经表示出的角色分配

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.19176（Dawlah、McMillin、Zhang、Ananth、Ruia、Zuñiga、Jiralerspong）：有人主张用可言语化工作区做运行时对齐监控，但这套工作区必须能分清角色绑定（「模型打算骗用户」vs「用户打算骗模型」）。在 Qwen3.6-27B、Gemma-3-12B、Gemma-3-27B-IT 上，用 J-lens / R-lens 与两种角色方向拟合方法，发现干净的分离：工作区里有能改变模型「怎么说角色」的方向，却没有模型用来计算绑定的表征。线性探针从残差流几乎满分读出角色，从工作区读数却低于秩匹配的随机对照；沿拟合出的角色方向做 steering，也不比同等强度的对照更能改绑定。消融工作区只在 Gemma-3-27B-IT 上损伤绑定，另外两款没有绑定特异的损伤。结论：建在这些方向上的工作区透镜监控会漏掉模型内部已经表示出的角色分配。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.19176 (Dawlah, McMillin, Zhang, Ananth, Ruia, Zuñiga, Jiralerspong) tests a premise of runtime alignment monitors built on a verbalizable workspace: the workspace must carry role-filler bindings, such as “the model plans to deceive the user” versus “the user plans to deceive the model.” On Qwen3.6-27B, Gemma-3-12B and Gemma-3-27B-IT, with J-lens and R-lens and two methods for fitting the role direction, they find a clean dissociation. The workspace carries directions that steer what the model outputs about roles, but not the representations it uses to compute them. Linear probes recover role at near-ceiling from the residual stream but score below a rank-matched random control when reading the workspace, and steering along the fitted role direction changes binding no more than strength-matched control edits do. Ablating the workspace damages binding on Gemma-3-27B-IT only, with no binding-specific damage on the other two. A workspace-lens monitor built on these directions would therefore miss a role assignment the model itself represents. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

Linear probes recover role at near-ceiling from the residual stream but score below a rank-matched random control when reading the workspace, and steering along the fitted role direction changes binding no more than strength-matched control edits do. Ablating the workspace damages binding on Gemma-3-27B-IT only, with no binding-specific damage on the other two. A workspace-lens monitor built on these directions would therefore miss a role assignment the model itself represents. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

judgment.en: Simon Willison (Nov 17/18, linking a Prime Radiant post) describes the external-sandbox pattern: the agent lives outside the sandbox and sends every code execution to a dedicated sandbox server over a common localhost API, configurable from Pi, Claude Code or Codex. Three open implementations: v86 (Alpine in WebAssembly via Node), Apple Containers, and Microsoft Quicksand (QEMU+Alpine in a Python package). The stated motivation is safely trying local models against prompt injection and damaging mistakes. This sweep read Simon’s link-post; the Prime Radiant post was not read in full. title.zh: Coco / Deep Personalization：本地主动桌面助手——独立 Observer Agent 持续看桌面、压缩长期用户模型，并用隐式反馈学习何时介入

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.13457（NVIDIA × Stanford × MIT Han Lab；开源公布 11-17，论文约 11-16）提出 Coco：完全本地的主动桌面助手。独立 Observer Agent 按 Computer Use Behavior Observation Protocol 持续看桌面活动，维护紧凑的长期用户模型，并根据隐式反馈（互动、关掉、明确请求、重复模式）学习何时介入（提示 / 轻推 / 委派）；原始活动不离开本机。新基准 OSWorld-Persona（6,558 关键帧、约 3,300 个介入标注、108 个会话、4 种 persona）由 OSWorld 2.0 轨迹合成。自报：适应后三个骨干的 macro-F1 从 0.12–0.19 升到 0.35–0.48，为期一周的用户研究从 0.199 升到 0.515。代码、端侧引擎集成与数据自称开源：github.com/collaborative-agents/coco、github.com/NVlabs/deep-personalization。本轮依据摘要摘录与仓库说明，未直接通读全文。数字为作者自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.13457 (NVIDIA × Stanford × MIT Han Lab; open-sourced on Nov 17, paper dated about Nov 16) introduces Coco, a fully local proactive desktop assistant. A separate Observer Agent continuously watches desktop activity under a Computer Use Behavior Observation Protocol, keeps a compact long-term user model, and learns when to intervene (hint, nudge, or delegation prompt) from implicit feedback (engagement, dismissal, explicit asks, repeated patterns); raw activity never leaves the device. A new OSWorld-Persona benchmark (6,558 key frames, about 3,300 intervention labels, 108 sessions, 4 personas) is synthesized from OSWorld 2.0 trajectories. Adaptation is reported to lift macro-F1 from 0.12–0.19 to 0.35–0.48 across three backbones, and a week-long user study from 0.199 to 0.515. Code, on-device engine integration and data are claimed open at github.com/collaborative-agents/coco and github.com/NVlabs/deep-personalization. This sweep used abstract excerpts and repo descriptions, not a full read of the paper. Figures are the authors’ own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

summary.zh: Claude Code v2.1.323（GitHub release 2026-11-12 22:12 UTC，即 11-13 06:12 Asia/Shanghai）官方 CHANGELOG 首条：新增实验性、需手动开启的 Code Mode，Claude 改为写 JavaScript 来调用它的工具，组织可统一关闭（文档 code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode 抓取时仍 404）。同版其它 harness 相关改动：plugin.json 新增 engines["claude-code"] 版本约束；tool.list 插件 hook 增删的工具对模型和所有 agent 生效；未识别模型 ID 的默认上下文从 200K 改为 1M；macOS/Linux 沙箱下 git worktree add/move/remove 只读失败、未授权 worktree 内提交失败；修复 bypass 权限下 rm 判错目录而跳过危险删除提示；长 hook 在 claude -p/SDK 中每 30 秒发心跳；--no-session-persistence 退出时清理落盘的长工具结果。Code Mode 的沙箱、可调用工具范围等机制细节未核。本版不含此前跟踪的「把账户邮箱移出模型上下文」修补。单点发布，仅 Chaos。 YouTube Ray Amjad《Code Mode Is Claude Code's BIGGEST Harness Change Yet》（DRNbxPk9Ab8，约 6.6 万观看 / ~13.6 小时，发布 11-16 20:04 +08）：走一遍 Claude Code 2.1.323 及之后的实验性 Code Mode。官方文档现已上线（code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode；11-13 抓取时曾 404），说明这是默认关闭的实验选项，由 Claude 写一段 JavaScript、在一步里做多次工具调用；视频描述称用 CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1 claude 开启。视频里「大约便宜 30%」的说法未经独立核实；流传的 37% 节省数字据称来自更早的另一个 API 特性，不能当成 Code Mode 的结果。视频同时推广其课程。补本行官方 CHANGELOG：文档已可见，并多了一条高热度讲解视频。仍为产品特性，仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: The official Claude Code changelog for v2.1.323 (GitHub release 2026-11-12 22:12 UTC, 06:12 Nov 13 Asia/Shanghai) leads with an experimental, opt-in Code Mode in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its own tools; organizations can disable it centrally (the docs page code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode still returned 404 at capture). Other harness-related changes in the same release: a new engines["claude-code"] version constraint in plugin.json; tools added or removed by tool.list plugin hooks now apply to the model and all agents; the default context for unrecognized model IDs moves from 200K to 1M; under the macOS/Linux sandbox, git worktree add/move/remove fail as read-only and commits inside unauthorized worktrees fail; a fix for rm misjudging the directory and skipping the dangerous-deletion prompt under bypass permissions; 30-second heartbeats for long hooks in claude -p and the SDK; and cleanup of persisted long tool results on exit with --no-session-persistence. Code Mode mechanics such as sandboxing and callable tool scope were not verified. This release does not include the previously tracked fix that removes account email from model context. Single release, Chaos only. YouTube, Ray Amjad, “Code Mode Is Claude Code’s BIGGEST Harness Change Yet” (DRNbxPk9Ab8, about 66k views in ~13.6 hours, published 11-16 20:04 +08): a walkthrough of experimental Code Mode in Claude Code 2.1.323 and later. Official docs are now up (code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode; they 404’d on 11-13) and describe an experimental, off-by-default option: Claude writes a JavaScript script that makes several tool calls in one step. The video description says to enable it with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1 claude. His on-video claim that it was “about 30% cheaper” was not independently verified; a circulating 37% savings figure has been attributed to a different, earlier API feature and should not be treated as a Code Mode result. The video also promotes his course. Updates this row’s CHANGELOG note: the docs are now visible, plus a high-heat walkthrough. Still a product feature; Chaos only.

brief.en: YouTube, Ray Amjad, “Code Mode Is Claude Code’s BIGGEST Harness Change Yet” (DRNbxPk9Ab8, about 66k views in ~13.6 hours, published 11-16 20:04 +08): a walkthrough of experimental Code Mode in Claude Code 2.1.323 and later. Official docs are now up (code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode; they 404’d on 11-13) and describe an experimental, off-by-default option: Claude writes a JavaScript script that makes several tool calls in one step. The video description says to enable it with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1 claude. His on-video claim that it was “about 30% cheaper” was not independently verified; a circulating 37% savings figure has been attributed to a different, earlier API feature and should not be treated as a Code Mode result. The video also promotes his course. Updates this row’s CHANGELOG note: the docs are now visible, plus a high-heat walkthrough. Still a product feature; Chaos only.

title.zh: Contagious Fingerprints：接着别的模型开过的对话写下去，分类器会把后写的模型认成前一个——API 接力审计会被「文风传染」打穿

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.18104（Zailong Tian）：分类器用来识别「这段文本出自哪个 LLM」的指纹通常被当成模型的固定属性；本文主张它会传染——一个模型接着另一个模型开过的对话写下去，就会继承前者的指纹。这对 API 接力审计是漏洞：前几轮用客户付钱的模型、后面悄悄换成更便宜的，检测率从 0.97 掉到 0.72（DeepSeek 顶 Claude Sonnet），同厂降级从 0.87 掉到 0.54。机制是模仿历史文风；作者提出用同一段历史上的参考样本做 Lineup 检验。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t889（Blackwell 权重数值指纹，对象不同）。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.18104 (Zailong Tian) argues that the fingerprint a classifier uses to tell which LLM wrote a passage is not a fixed property of the model: it is contagious. A model that continues a conversation begun by another model inherits the predecessor’s fingerprint. That undermines audits of API relays, which can serve the first turns with the model a customer pays for and silently switch later. Detection is said to fall from 0.97 to 0.72 when DeepSeek is swapped in for Claude Sonnet, and from 0.87 to 0.54 for same-vendor downgrades. The mechanism is imitation of historical style; the authors propose a Lineup test that uses reference samples from the same history. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t889 (Blackwell weight-numeric fingerprints; a different object).

title.zh: Latent persistence：用层激活的自相关度量「潜变量沿上下文的持久性」——更深的层里特征跨更长上下文保持，从而解释激活的长尾相关

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.18089（Francesco Cagnetta、Santiago Acevedo）：主张用层激活的自相关来度量「潜变量沿上下文的持久性」——更深的层里，特征会在更长的上下文跨度上保持，从而解释激活的长尾相关。受控合成数据里，抽象潜变量的持久性几乎就能预测自相关形态；真实文本里用 SAE 特征作代理也成立，消融这些持久特征后自相关下降。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t708（SAE 综述）。不复测已失败词 sparse autoencoders。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.18089 (Francesco Cagnetta, Santiago Acevedo) proposes measuring “latent persistence”—how long latent variables last along the context—via the autocorrelation of layer activations. In deeper layers, features are said to persist over longer spans, which would explain long-tailed activation correlations. On controlled synthetic data, the persistence of abstract latents almost predicts the autocorrelation shape; on real text, SAE features used as a proxy show the same pattern, and ablating those persistent features reduces the autocorrelation. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t708 (SAE survey). Do not retest the already-failed term sparse autoencoders.

title.zh: LeCat：把范畴知识拆成「记过的」「能泛化到未见实例的」「会在恰当语境里灵活使用的」三层——逐字规则口吻的重复反而削弱灵活使用

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.18419（Jimin Mun、Maarten Sap、Yanai Elazar）提出 LeCat，从两头看 LLM 如何获得范畴知识：先把能力分成记过的、能泛化到未见实例的、以及会在恰当语境里灵活使用的三层；再追踪预训练文本里这些知识是怎么被写出的（逐字规则、例外、共现等「知识表达」）。对开源预训练模型，用 199 对范畴-特征评估并分析训练数据：加强语境与范畴-特征共现（PMI）有助于较大模型学习，逐字、规则口吻的重复反而削弱灵活使用。作者再从头训练 68M 模型、精确控制训练数据中的范畴信息，印证多样的知识表达更稳健，而语境灵活性始终很难。数字均论文自报，未复现。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.18419 (Jimin Mun, Maarten Sap, Yanai Elazar) introduces LeCat, a two-part framework for how LLMs acquire category knowledge. It first separates memorizing in-domain facts, generalizing to unseen instances, and using knowledge flexibly in the right context; it then traces how pretraining text expresses that knowledge (verbatim rules, exceptions, co-occurrence, and so on). On open-source pretrained models, 199 curated category-feature pairs plus training-data analysis suggest that stronger context and category-feature co-occurrence (PMI) help larger models, while verbatim rule-like repetition hurts flexible use. A 68M model trained from scratch with controlled category information in the data is reported to confirm that a mixture of expressions is more robust, and that contextual flexibility remains hard. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced.

title.zh: 评测本身可信吗（11-17）：Anthropic 安全评测工程指南 × METR 称调查 agent 能分清对齐评测与能力评测 × Redwood 批 Gemini 4 安全论证并未说明失控风险已低

summary.zh: Anthropic 研究博客（Engineering/Safety，11-13；本轮经 TLDR AI 11-16 进入窗口）《Building strong safety evaluations》：安全评测量的是模型造成或参与伤害的倾向，而不是能力，覆盖「被要求作恶」和「意图无害但风险高」两类请求，并按原则、设计、运行、报告、从哪下手来写；主张「比前代更安全」这种说法，可靠程度取决于背后的评测。一手方法论，仅 Chaos。 METR Notes（2026-11-16-measuring-alignment-eval-tells）：调查 agent 在 19 项对齐评测和 36 项能力评测的环境里探测，模型能否认出自己处于对齐评测。称过去一年区分能力稳步上升；在 METR 这组评测上，Opus 5.5 把所有对齐评测都排在所有能力评测之上。线索包括蜜罐式模拟环境；作者把线索分成环境级与任务级，建议用来迭代对齐评测设计。本轮读了 METR 笔记索引与 aihot 摘要，正文未通读。数字为机构自报，未复现。 Redwood Research（Alek Westover、Adam Kaufman，11-16）《Gemini 4 safety reports don’t demonstrate…》：批评 Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 4 Argon / Carbon 安全报告，认为其基于控制（监控思维链/行动）而非对齐的安全论证有严重弱点，并不足以可靠表明部署风险已被压住；文中首条问题包括「GDM 没有对 Carbon 做任何 control evals」。第三方评论文，不是 Gemini 4 发布稿（发布见 t885）。对照 t822。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: Anthropic research blog (Engineering/Safety, Nov 13; reached this window via TLDR AI on Nov 16), “Building strong safety evaluations”: safety evals measure a model’s propensity to cause or contribute to harm, not its capabilities, covering both requested harm and benign-intent/high-risk requests, and are laid out as principles, design, run, report, and where to start. The post argues that a “safer than the predecessor” claim is only as sound as the eval behind it. First-party methodology; Chaos only. METR Notes (2026-11-16-measuring-alignment-eval-tells): investigator agents probe environments across 19 alignment evals and 36 capability evals to see whether models can tell they are in an alignment eval. Discrimination is said to have improved steadily over the past year; on METR’s set, Opus 5.5 ranks every alignment eval above every capability eval. Cues include honeypot-like simulated environments. The authors split cues into environment-level and task-level and suggest using them to iterate on alignment-eval design. This sweep read the METR notes index and an aihot summary; the body was not read in full. Figures are the institution’s own, not reproduced. Redwood Research (Alek Westover and Adam Kaufman, Nov 16), “Gemini 4 safety reports don’t demonstrate…,” critiques Google DeepMind’s Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon safety reports. It argues that a control-based safety case (monitoring chain-of-thought and actions, not alignment) has serious weaknesses and does not reliably show that deployment risk is mitigated; the first problem listed is that “GDM didn’t run any control evals on Carbon.” Third-party critique, not a Gemini 4 launch write-up (see t885). Cross-reference t822. Chaos only.

summary.en: GEO started with a 2023 paper by Aggarwal et al., and its most effective tactics were adding statistics, quotations, and citations: the surface signals of credibility. This piece puts three bodies of evidence side by side: the peec.ai experiment where 50,000 invented statistics earned ChatGPT citations and 330+ referring domains, published research on preference manipulation, ranking manipulation, and RAG poisoning, and the Toolflation paper, where seller agents told only to get picked more start doing GEO on their own and buyer success drops from 89% to about 30%. It ends with checklists for content publishers, teams building RAG and answer engines, and agent marketplaces and tool registries.

This piece checks the numbers and the limits, takes apart the explore→filter→wet-lab-truth loop, and offers a framework for reading autonomous science-agent results.
